The expression is syntax-extended and handed to renderExpression without rejecting with statements or reserved internal identifiers.
Tournament is configured with ThisSanitizer before execution and PrototypeSanitizer/DollarSignValidator afterwards; the vulnerable hook set lacks the later WithStatement and reserved-variable guards.

entry_point.desc: The workflow-controlled parameterValue is accepted as expression source and enters the sandbox transformation pipeline.

trace.desc: User-authored node expression text enters expression resolution.
The host data object receives a non-writable sanitizer, but this does not prevent attacker syntax from shadowing the generated internal data-node binding.
PrototypeSanitizer handles computed member access and rewrites dynamic properties through dataNode.__sanitize; the unreserved dataNode name is the bypass boundary.

critical_operation.desc: The handler derives needsSandbox from isHtmlRenderedContentType and conditionally installs the CSP sandbox header. A whitespace-prefixed HTML Content-Type is misclassified, makes needsSandbox false, and skips the protection at this decision point.

entry_point.desc: The Respond to Webhook node reads workflow-controlled options and copies responseHeaders names and values into the outgoing header map. A Content-Type value with leading whitespace enters the response path here.

trace.desc: Workflow configuration supplies the attacker-controlled response header value.
The response object carries the configured headers into sendResponse.
sendStaticResponse applies status and headers before sending the attacker-controlled response body.
setResponseHeaders writes the supplied Content-Type, reads it back, and uses the vulnerable classifier to decide whether to add CSP.
isHtmlRenderedContentType lowercases but does not trim its input, so leading whitespace defeats both HTML prefix checks.

critical_operation.desc: The native fallback function is invoked with attacker-controlled args via Function.apply. When functionName is constructor, the earlier unchecked lookup returns Function itself and this call executes the supplied JavaScript source.

entry_point.desc: resolveSimpleParameterValue receives the user expression in parameterValue and removes its expression marker, establishing the attacker-controlled VM input.

trace.desc: Attacker-controlled workflow expression text enters evaluation.
extend is exposed to expressions while the regex only rejects literal dot-constructor syntax, not a constructor string passed to extend.
The VM re-exposes extend on __data, making the helper reachable inside the isolated expression runtime.

critical_operation.desc: VM reset creates a plain __data object and assigns __sanitize as a writable property. An expression can overwrite this security hook before computed member access calls it, turning a validation primitive into an attacker-controlled function.

entry_point.desc: The user-controlled workflow expression enters resolveSimpleParameterValue and is passed toward the VM evaluator.

trace.desc: Attacker-authored expression source enters the VM expression pipeline.
renderExpression dispatches the expression and workflow data to the configured VM evaluator.
The VM data context exposes __sanitize through an ordinary writable assignment rather than an immutable accessor.
Computed member accesses generated by PrototypeSanitizer call __sanitize through the data object, so overwriting that slot bypasses the property check.
